knowledge:
- key_parameters: count=A vector assigned to the fit object (e.g., fit3$count) containing the number of PSMs or peptides quantified for each protein ;; coef_col=The column index of the contrast of interest in the fit object passed to outputResult ;; n=An integer passed to VarianceBoxplot to limit the plot to proteins quantified by <= n PSMs/peptides ;; group_col=The column index or name in the PSM table containing the gene/protein identifier passed to medianSweeping
- alternatives: Limma=Assumes a common prior variance for all proteins, whereas DEqMS is preferred for proteomics because it models variance as a function of PSM/peptide count ;; Ordinary t-test / ANOVA=Do not moderate variance using empirical Bayesian approaches, whereas DEqMS shrinks posterior variance toward the fitted curve
- when_to_use: Use when performing differential expression analysis on proteomics data (TMT, label-free LFQ, or isobaric labeled data) where proteins are quantified by varying numbers of PSMs or peptides.
- pitfalls: If min(fit3$count) returns NA or 0, the user must troubleshoot this error before running spectraCounteBayes ;; For label-free data, minimum peptide count can be 0, so a pseudocount of 1 should be added to all proteins ;; DEqMS requires a minimum of two values for each group, so rows with too many missing values must be filtered out ;; Log2 transformation is required for relative abundance (ratios) or intensity values before analysis

workflows.name: protein_table_tmt
workflows.intent: Perform differential protein expression analysis using a pre-summarized protein abundance table (e.g., TMT data).
input: miR_Proteintable.txt (tabular text file containing protein accession, TMT quantification columns, and PSM count columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Read and filter protein table ;; 2. Log2 transform and check normalization ;; 3. Define design matrix and contrasts ;; 4. Fit linear model using Limma (lmFit, contrasts.fit, eBayes) ;; 5. Assign PSM count to the fit object ;; 6. Run DEqMS variance estimation (spectraCounteBayes) ;; 7. Visualize variance dependence (VarianceBoxplot, VarianceScatterplot) ;; 8. Extract results (outputResult)
workflows.code:
df.prot = read.table("miR_Proteintable.txt",stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                     header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "",sep = "\t")
TMT_columns = seq(15,33,2)
dat = df.prot[df.prot$miR.FASP_q.value<0.01,TMT_columns]
rownames(dat) = df.prot[df.prot$miR.FASP_q.value<0.01,]$Protein.accession
dat.log = log2(dat)
dat.log = na.omit(dat.log)
cond = as.factor(c("ctrl","miR191","miR372","miR519","ctrl",
"miR372","miR519","ctrl","miR191","miR372"))
design = model.matrix(~0+cond)
colnames(design) = gsub("cond","",colnames(design))
x <- c("miR372-ctrl","miR519-ctrl","miR191-ctrl",
       "miR372-miR519","miR372-miR191","miR519-miR191")
contrast =  makeContrasts(contrasts=x,levels=design)
fit1 <- lmFit(dat.log, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit1,contrasts = contrast)
fit3 <- eBayes(fit2)
count_columns = seq(16,34,2)
psm.count.table = data.frame(count = rowMins(
  as.matrix(df.prot[,count_columns])), row.names =  df.prot$Protein.accession)
fit3$count = psm.count.table[rownames(fit3$coefficients),"count"]
fit4 = spectraCounteBayes(fit3)
VarianceBoxplot(fit4,n=30,main="TMT10plex dataset PXD004163",xlab="PSM count")
VarianceScatterplot(fit4,main="TMT10plex dataset PXD004163")
DEqMS.results = outputResult(fit4,coef_col = 1)

workflows.name: maxquant_lfq
workflows.intent: Perform differential protein expression analysis using MaxQuant label-free quantification (LFQ) output.
workflows.stages: 1. Read and filter out decoy/contaminant matches ;; 2. Extract LFQ intensity columns and filter for missing values ;; 3. Extract unique/razor peptide counts and add a pseudocount of 1 ;; 4. Log2 transform intensities ;; 5. Define design matrix and contrasts ;; 6. Fit linear model using Limma (lmFit, contrasts.fit, eBayes) ;; 7. Assign peptide count to the fit object ;; 8. Run DEqMS variance estimation (spectraCounteBayes) ;; 9. Extract results (outputResult)
workflows.code:
df.prot = read.table("proteinGroups.txt",header=T,sep="\t",stringsAsFactors = F,
                        comment.char = "",quote ="")
df.prot = df.prot[!df.prot$Reverse=="+",]
df.prot = df.prot[!df.prot$Contaminant=="+",]
df.LFQ = df.prot[,89:94]
df.LFQ[df.LFQ==0] <- NA
rownames(df.LFQ) = df.prot$Majority.protein.IDs
df.LFQ$na_count_H = apply(df.LFQ,1,function(x) sum(is.na(x[1:3])))
df.LFQ$na_count_L = apply(df.LFQ,1,function(x) sum(is.na(x[4:6])))
df.LFQ.filter = df.LFQ[df.LFQ$na_count_H<2 & df.LFQ$na_count_L<2,1:6]
pep.count.table = data.frame(count = rowMins(as.matrix(df.prot[,19:24])),
                             row.names = df.prot$Majority.protein.IDs)
pep.count.table$count = pep.count.table$count+1
protein.matrix = log2(as.matrix(df.LFQ.filter))
class = as.factor(c("H","H","H","L","L","L"))
design = model.matrix(~0+class)
fit1 = lmFit(protein.matrix,design = design)
cont <- makeContrasts(classH-classL, levels = design)
fit2 = contrasts.fit(fit1,contrasts = cont)
fit3 <- eBayes(fit2)
fit3$count = pep.count.table[rownames(fit3$coefficients),"count"]
min(fit3$count)
fit4 = spectraCounteBayes(fit3)
VarianceBoxplot(fit4, n=20, main = "Label-free dataset PXD000279",
                xlab="peptide count + 1")
DEqMS.results = outputResult(fit4,coef_col = 1)

workflows.name: psm_table_isobaric
workflows.intent: Summarize PSM-level isobaric labeled data to protein-level relative abundance and perform differential expression analysis.
input: dat.psm (PSM-level quantification table with peptide, gene/protein ID, and channel intensity columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Log2 transform PSM intensities ;; 2. Summarize PSM intensities to protein log2 ratios using median sweeping (medianSweeping) ;; 3. Define design matrix and contrasts ;; 4. Fit linear model using Limma (lmFit, contrasts.fit, eBayes) ;; 5. Calculate PSM count per gene/protein and assign to the fit object ;; 6. Run DEqMS variance estimation (spectraCounteBayes) ;; 7. Extract results (outputResult) ;; 8. Plot peptide profiles for specific genes (peptideProfilePlot)
workflows.code:
dat.psm.log = dat.psm
dat.psm.log[,3:12] =  log2(dat.psm[,3:12])
dat.gene.nm = medianSweeping(dat.psm.log,group_col = 2)
gene.matrix = as.matrix(dat.gene.nm)
cond = as.factor(c("ctrl","miR191","miR372","miR519","ctrl",
"miR372","miR519","ctrl","miR191","miR372"))
design = model.matrix(~0+cond)
colnames(design) = gsub("cond","",colnames(design))
fit1 <- lmFit(gene.matrix,design)
x <- c("miR372-ctrl","miR519-ctrl","miR191-ctrl")
contrast =  makeContrasts(contrasts=x,levels=design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit1,contrasts = contrast))
psm.count.table = as.data.frame(table(dat.psm$gene))
rownames(psm.count.table) = psm.count.table$Var1
fit2$count = psm.count.table[rownames(fit2$coefficients),2]
fit3 = spectraCounteBayes(fit2)
DEqMS.results = outputResult(fit3,coef_col = 1)
VarianceBoxplot(fit3,n=20, xlab="PSM count",main="TMT10plex dataset PXD004163")
peptideProfilePlot(dat=dat.psm.log,col=2,gene="TGFBR2")
